sections.heading: Apple TV 4K and the Environment
sections.source_text:
Progress towards Apple 2030
Apple 2030 is our goal to be carbon neutral across our value chain. We design our products to be less carbon intensive by prioritising the use of recycled and renewable content and low‑carbon materials while focusing on the energy efficiency of our software and hardware.
See Apple’s commitment
Materials
80% recycled aluminium in the thermal module of Apple TV 4K (4th generation)
100% recycled aluminium in the enclosure housing of the Siri Remote (4th generation)
100% recycled copper in multiple printed circuit boards
100% recycled gold plating and tin solder in all Apple-designed printed circuit boards
100% recycled rare earth elements in all magnets
Packaging
100% fibre‑based packaging
Smarter chemistry 11
All the materials used in Apple products, accessories and packaging are covered by the requirements of our Regulated Substances Specification (PDF) , which was one of the first in industry to restrict the use of key substances of concern. See the latest Environmental Progress Report (PDF) to understand Apple’s recent efforts in phasing out these chemistries.
